name: Sale
description: The village's own little Sale at the end of Vanha Kylätie. Groceries, a bakery corner, the scratch-card stand and the bottle return machine.
greeting: The bottle return machine clinks and rattles.
A bulletin board full of lost cats and tractors for sale.
Warm pulla smell from the bakery corner.
Someone is complaining about the price of coffee.

hello: Moi moi! Got your bonus card?
Did you hear about the neighbour's new car? Of course you did.
groceries: That'll do you for the week.
Rye bread is on offer, I put one in.
coffee_pulla: The coffee corner is all yours.
work: Good shift. The milk shelf looks tidy.
Nobody stole the karkki this time. Well done.
hired: Welcome to the team! The vest is in the back.
You start right away. The bottle machine is jammed.
rejected: Sorry, we hired the neighbour's nephew.
Not this time. Try again later?
broke: Card declined, dear. Happens to everyone.

lines: You feed the bottle machine a can. It thinks for a long time, then spits it back out in disgust.
The bottle machine prints a receipt for 15 cents. You feel rich, briefly.
Someone has left a whole bag of empties next to the machine with a note: "for whoever needs them". Finnish kindness, in its purest form.
